interpretation: Durations are monotonic wall time in microseconds, including instrumentation overhead. Parent totals include child time; never sum the phase totals as end-to-end latency. self_us subtracts direct children only and is unknown for a source/process with an unobserved parent. Complete counts describe matched scope pairs, not a complete observation tree or product success. Scope completion is not a physical send. started_unix_us is for log correlation only; wall-clock changes do not affect elapsed_us.
